;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[2020 Monguno and Nganzai massacres]]
**[[Boko Haram|ISWAP]] kills over 20 [[Nigerian Army|soldier]]s and 40 civilians in [[Boko Haram insurgency|attacks]] in [[Monguno]] and [[Nganzai]] in [[Borno State|Borno]], [[Nigeria]] – four days after they [[Gubio massacre|killed 82 civilians]] in [[Gubio]]. [https://uk.reuters.com/article/uk-nigeria-security-idUKKBN23K0VY (Reuters)]
*[[Saudi Arabian-led intervention in Yemen]]
**Coalition spokesman Turki al-Malki says the [[armed forces]] destroyed a [[ballistic missile]] targeting the [[Saudi Arabia|Saudi]] border city of [[Najran]]. In a statement, the spokesman said the missile was launched from the [[Yemen]]i city of [[Saada]] and that some people were slightly injured when it was destroyed. The Houthis did not claim responsibility. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2020/06/saudi-led-coalition-destroyed-missile-targeting-najran-200613144607924.html (Al Jazeera)]

;Health and environment
*[[COVID-19 pandemic in Chile]]
**More than 3,100 deaths are officially reported in the country. However, an investigation reported the Ministry of Health told the [[World Health Organization]] that the death toll reached 5,000 cases. [https://www.france24.com/en/20200613-chile-replaces-health-minister-as-covid-19-deaths-spike (France24)]
**[[Jaime Mañalich]] is succeeded by [[Enrique Paris]] as [[Ministry of Health of Chile|Minister of Health]]. [https://www.france24.com/en/20200613-chile-replaces-health-minister-as-covid-19-deaths-spike (France24)]

;International relations
*[[Czech Republic–Poland relations]], [[COVID-19 pandemic in Poland]]
**[[Poland]]'s [[Ministry of National Defence (Poland)|Ministry of National Defence]] admits its [[Polish Land Forces|army]] briefly invaded and occupied the [[Czech Republic]] for several days last month in a "misunderstanding", the Polish soldiers took up positions near a chapel on the Czech side of the border in [[Moravia]] as part of coronavirus measures, and prevented Czech visitors from the site. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-53034930 (BBC News)]

;Law and crime
*[[Killing of Rayshard Brooks]]
**[[George Floyd protests in Atlanta|Protestors]] [[arson|set fire to]] a [[Wendy's]] restaurant in [[Atlanta]], [[Georgia (U.S. state)|Georgia]], U.S., in response to Rayshard Brooks' death the evening before. Outside the restaurant the previous day, two [[Atlanta Police Department|police]] officers shot Brooks after he attempted to escape from them after a tussle in which he took one of the officer's taser and discharged it at one of them following a [[driving under the influence|DUI]] investigation. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2020/jun/14/rayshard-brooks-shooting-protesters-set-fire-to-restaurant-where-black-man-shot-dead (''The Guardian'')]
*[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United Kingdom]]; [[Crime in Greater Manchester]]
**A man is killed, a woman raped and three others stabbed at two "quarantine [[Rave|raves]]" late Saturday that attracted 6,000 people in [[Greater Manchester]]. They were a clear breach of coronavirus legislation. [https://www.bbc.com/news/uk-england-manchester-53040827 (BBC News)]
*A court in [[China]] sentences an [[Australians|Australian]] man [[capital punishment in China|to death]] for [[drug trafficking]]. The man had been arrested in 2013 at [[Baiyun Airport]] in [[Guangzhou]]. The [[Australian government]] condemns the verdict. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-australia-china-drugtrafficking-sente/china-sentences-australian-to-death-in-fresh-blow-to-relations-idUSKBN23K099?il=0 (Reuters)]
*[[Colombians|Colombian]] businessman [[Alex Saab]] is arrested in [[Cape Verde]] a week after [[Government of Colombia|Colombian authorities]] froze his assets following the opening an investigation against him for alleged [[money laundering]]. The [[Nicolás Maduro]]-led [[Government of Venezuela]] denounces the arrest as an [[arbitrary detention]] and violation of international law. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-venezuela-corruption/colombian-businessman-close-to-venezuelas-maduro-arrested-idUSKBN23K0OT?il=0 (Reuters)]

;Politics and elections
*[[George Floyd protests]]
**[[George Floyd protests in the United States]]
***[[George Floyd protests in California]]
****[[George Floyd protests in San Diego County, California|Protesters]] gather outside the [[One America News Network]] headquarters in [[San Diego]], [[California]], [[United States|US]] for their misinformation about the [[Buffalo police shoving incident]], including labeling protester Martin Gugino as a “[[Antifa (United States)|Antifa]] provocateur”. [https://timesofsandiego.com/politics/2020/06/13/protesters-label-one-america-news-network-as-lies-at-san-diego-hq/ (''Times of San Diego'')]
**[[George Floyd protests in the United Kingdom]]
***Protests organized by [[Black Lives Matter]] are cancelled in [[London]] before the arrival of counter-protesters, including members of the [[Far-right politics in the United Kingdom|far-right]], although some BLM supporters arrived. Far-right protesters and police clashed at a demonstration in [[Trafalgar Square]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/uk-53031072 (BBC News)] [https://uk.reuters.com/article/minneapolis-police-protests-britain-lond/far-right-protesters-and-police-scuffle-in-londons-trafalgar-square-idUKKBN23K0HL (Reuters)] [https://www.thetimes.co.uk/article/far-right-gangs-to-target-black-lives-matter-protesters-f2kvwp9kn (''The Times'')]
**[[Law enforcement in France|French riot police]] clash with [[anti-racism]] protesters in central [[Paris]], as thousands march onto the [[Place de la République]] to protest [[police brutality]] against the country's [[Immigration to France|immigrants]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-minneapolis-police-protests-france/anti-racism-protesters-clash-with-police-in-paris-idUSKBN23K0J3?il=0 (Reuters)]
*[[2020 Polish presidential election]], [[LGBT rights in Poland]]
**[[President of Poland|President]] [[Andrzej Duda]] compares the "[[Homosexual agenda|LGBT ideology]]" to "[[Communism|communist]] indoctrination" ahead of the upcoming presidential elections. Opposition candidate [[Robert Biedroń]] condemns his remarks. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-poland-election-lgbt/polish-president-compares-lgbt-ideology-to-soviet-indoctrination-idUSKBN23K0GN?il=0 (Reuters)]
